On MuSiQue-Ans, the C-only artifact model gets **3.4 answer F1 and 0.0 support F1** on the validation set, and **3.7 answer F1 and 0.0 support F1** on the test set.

**Page numbers:** The document has no printed page numbers. I counted pages from the start of the paper, so the references below are estimates.

**Validation set (Table 4, p. 11)**
- The C-only model scores 3.4 answer F1 and 0.0 support F1 on MuSiQue-Ans.
- The same model does much better on the comparison datasets:
  - HotpotQA-20K: 18.4 answer F1 and 67.6 support F1.
  - 2WikiMultihopQA-20K: 50.1 answer F1 and 92.0 support F1.
- The authors note that support identification on those two datasets "can be done to a surprisingly high degree (67.6 and 92.0 F1) even without the question (C-only model), but fails on MuSiQue-Ans" (p. 11).
- Tables 6 and 7 (p. 11–12) repeat the 3.4 and 0.0 figures for the final dataset, which uses 20 positive-distractor paragraphs.

**Test set (Table 5, p. 11)**
- On MuSiQue-Ans, the C-only model scores 3.7 answer F1 and 0.0 support F1.
- On MuSiQue-Full, it scores 1.6 An+Sf and 1.1 Sp+Sf.
- Table 5 uses test-set numbers, while the other results are on the validation set (p. 10).

**What the C-only model is (p. 10)**
It is an artifact-based model that sees only the context and not the question. It is built as an End2End Longformer-Large model with an empty question.
